input.rationale: The Agreement contains no non-compete, exclusivity or competitive-restraint covenant binding Client. Section 8 (Covenants and Warranties of Client) is limited to legal compliance, non-misrepresentation of underwriting decisions, access controls, content warranties and anti-spam; Sections 7, 10 and 12 likewise impose no business restraint. Section 2(a) affirmatively preserves our freedom to acquire, develop or license competing software and services, subject only to non-infringement of TrueLink's IP and our confidentiality obligations — which benefits us. The "ordinary course of its business of the origination, underwriting, processing and funding of consumer finance receivables" wording in 2(a) is a scope-of-licence field-of-use limit on how the Interface may be used, not a restriction on the businesses we may operate or the products we may buy or build, so it does not engage this rule. The cross-reference in Section 8(d) to a separate Non-Competition Agreement operates as a limitation on TrueLink's rights to use Credit Data (again in our favour); that separate agreement is not part of this document and should be diligenced separately, but nothing here restrains Client. This meets the preferred position (no non-compete or field-of-use restriction on Customer), so no redline is required.
